name: Corporate Action Event Stage 2 Code
definition: Specifies the stage of the corporate action event.

PWAL.name: Action Period
PWAL.definition: Open for acceptance until the next specified deadline in the announcement (if any).

SUAP.name: Subject To Approval
SUAP.definition: Subject to approval at the relevant meeting, eg, dividend.

APPD.name: Approved
APPD.definition: Approved at the relevant meeting, eg, dividend.

UNAC.name: Unconditional As To Acceptance
UNAC.definition: The required level of acceptances specified in the terms of the offer has been achieved but there are still outstanding conditions to fulfil.

WHOU.name: Wholly Unconditional
WHOU.definition: Wholly unconditional; all conditions specified in the offer document have been satisfied.

CLDE.name: Deactivated
CLDE.definition: The offer is closed for acceptance.

LAPS.name: Lapsed
LAPS.definition: The event/offer conditions have not been met and the event/offer is terminated or lapsed.
